Xbox Hub private-source build validation trigger
Request: run complete Windows build, signed-manifest tests, encrypted package round trip with encrypted RSA recipient key, tamper rejection, and updater transaction tests
Source version: 0.1.7-preview.1
Source commit: 4d3d2abf459f8eccb0daefda9c1731f27bf10640
Scope: Windows x64 restore, app/updater publish, exact two-file ZIP validation, offline signer positive/negative tests, AES-256-GCM/RSA-OAEP package encryption/decryption round trip using encrypted RSA-3072 recipient key, tamper rejection, and updater transaction tests.
Security: test keys and test passphrase are ephemeral runner-only values and are deleted. No production keys or secrets are used. No plaintext package, source archive, production key, TLS key, Cloudflare token, or credential is uploaded. Optional ciphertext upload remains disabled until the owner's public encryption key is configured.
